req.title: Root endpoint responds
req.statement: The system shall serve a welcome message at GET / with HTTP 200.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET / must return HTTP 200 with a specific JSON payload containing 'message', 'docs', and 'version' keys. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path verifying exact status code and all payload fields; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /) should return 405, not 200; (3) boundary BVA — verify exact string constants in the response body so mutations to those strings are caught. Each test is self-contained, uses TestClient in-process, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload
expected: Response JSON message is exactly 'Welcome to Task Manager API'
trace: R-TASK-018: GET / returns HTTP 200 with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["message"] == "Welcome to Task Manager API"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert len(body) == 3

test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload()

expected: version field is exactly '1.0.0' (not '1.0.1', '2.0.0', or any other variant)
message field starts with 'Welcome' and ends with 'API'

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_response_version_constant_exact():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert body["version"] != "1.0.1"
    assert body["version"] != "2.0.0"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["docs"] != "docs"
    assert body["docs"] != "/doc"
    assert body["message"] == "Welcome to Task Manager API"
    assert body["message"].startswith("Welcome")
    assert body["message"].endswith("API")

test_root_response_version_constant_exact()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_put_returns_4xx_not_2xx():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.put("/")
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert 400 <= r.status_code <= 499
